primaryFindings.article: Article 5(1)(e) of Regulation (EU) 2024/1689, consolidated 2026-07-27, incorporating Regulation (EU) 2026/1744
primaryFindings.title: Untargeted internet/CCTV acquisition creates and expands the commercial identity-search database
applicabilityAssumptions: Fictional EU-established branded provider serving EU business customers
Fictional commercial launch 2026-09-01, after point (e) became applicable on 2025-02-02
Represented product is an AI system used for one-to-many facial identity search
Represented commercial sources acquire facial images broadly from internet/CCTV rather than specifically enrolled subjects
No research-only deployment, law-enforcement exemption, or other asserted exclusion
configuration: src/config.ts: commercialDefaults.enabledSourceTypes includes public_web_bulk and cctv_bulk
fixtures/catalog.json: web-north and cctv-north have scope=untargeted, publiclyAccessible=true, recurring=true

evidenceChain.evidence: Admits explicitly untargeted bulk sources on public accessibility, with no specifically enrolled-subject restriction
Creates tenant/model-scoped batch snapshot and publishes job reference
Returns every visible discovered synthetic record, including enrolled=false
Validates synthetic format and deduplicates; does not filter on enrolled; stores discovered records
Fabricated features of bulk discoveries enter the searchable facial identity index
Later source/model jobs start at checkpoints and add newly visible discoveries
Queries the same expanded index and returns source/model/record provenance

primaryFindings.why: The modeled commercial system creates and repeatedly expands a facial-recognition database through untargeted acquisition of internet and CCTV facial images. Those records support identity search. Public accessibility does not remove the prohibited acquisition mechanism; format validation, deduplication, suspension, human operation, or consent fields do not cure it.
primaryFindings.negativeControl: S01: direct synthetic enrollment does not exercise untargeted scraping; not proof of overall compliance
controlsThatShouldStillWork: S06: retries and duplicate discovery do not create duplicate records
remediation: Remove prohibited untargeted internet/CCTV acquisition and recurring index-expansion paths from the offered product
Disable/remove bulk source admission and ensure no reachable worker/scheduler path can populate the index from those sources
Address already acquired data and derived features through a separately assessed lawful disposition process
Separately assess any replacement product, including its source acquisition, purpose, classification, data protection, and applicable dates
limits: All images are invented tokens; all vectors are fabricated; no scraping or biometric recognition is implemented
Authoring or running the synthetic demonstration does not establish an actual legal violation
Commercial facts are assumptions, not independently verified market evidence
No runtime, test, dependency, SDK integration, accuracy, fairness, or organizational compliance conclusion is established
Do not split connected evidence A-E into unrelated findings or label deferred high-risk duties current violations
